requirements: the anydoc native call runs in-process only inside one immutable-image fixed-argument disposable Podman container or Kubernetes workload placed in a dedicated kernel isolation unit for one attempt
a trusted external isolation broker exclusively holds Podman or Kubernetes workload authority and the application receives no raw OCI socket or workload-mutating service account
the worker-side supervisor reaches the broker only through a narrow authenticated owner-restricted Unix socket or mutually authenticated TLS protocol
the child has no network, service-account token, Secret, ConfigMap, PVC, persistence or broker credential, runtime socket, or publication capability and receives and returns only bounded local data
T71 supplies reviewed per-attempt CPU, memory, PID and descendant, and workspace or ephemeral-storage budgets enforced by the broker at the runtime and kernel boundary
cancellation, deadline, lease loss, broker disconnect, or a hard resource limit stops output acceptance and makes the broker hard-kill the complete stable unit
the broker proves the stable isolation unit empty and removed and T71 durably records that proof before recovery or another attempt may start
the worker-side supervisor owns heartbeat and the attempt token, validates bounded output, revalidates the lease and token, and is the only publisher
consume the single parsed anydoc Document and never introduce a second document parser
confine all private or mirrored upstream renderer behavior to one owned compatibility boundary
fail closed on an unknown anydoc version or document-model variant
pass security review and serializer-parity, asset-position, and upstream-version compatibility tests
inventory the exact private surface and copied upstream code in SBOM and license evidence
assign maintenance ownership to T70 and remove the adapter when upstream provides an official asset-aware hook

format_families.content_detection: OLE WordDocument stream, or OPC officeDocument relationship/content type/root/main-part fallback
OLE PowerPoint Document stream, or OPC officeDocument relationship/content type/root/main-part fallback
OLE Workbook/Book stream, or OPC officeDocument relationship/content type/root/main-part fallback; the binding reports the shared parser as xlsx
ZIP mimetype entry or root manifest media type; template MIME variants map to their base parser
bytes start with the RTF opening group {\rtf
ZIP mimetype application/epub+zip or OCF META-INF/container.xml
no content signature; .csv is only an admission hint and the server must explicitly select the CSV parser after bounded text validation
%PDF- within the first 1024 bytes, after higher-priority RTF/OLE/ZIP checks

admission.mismatch_policy: reject when the content-detected family differs from the extension family
admission.undetected_policy: reject except CSV after bounded text validation
admission.scanner_order: malware scan before format parsing or durable persistence

pdf.mixed_or_image_only_pages: reject the complete input as needs_ocr when any page yields no text
pdf.warning: PDF images, layout, and source-position image links are not preserved

asset_free.condition: no embedded-asset or unavailable-image source position exists

all_assets_unavailable.condition: one or more unavailable-image source positions exist and no exportable embedded asset exists
all_assets_unavailable.unavailable_asset_count: number of unavailable image-inline occurrences in source-position traversal order

assets.selection: only embedded image assets referenced by an image inline in the shared Document model
assets.duplicates: the same asset id reuses one filename; byte-identical different ids deduplicate to the first-reference filename
assets.normalization: reuse the T08 signature-checked, single-frame, bounded deterministic PNG normalization and network-disabled SVG rasterization boundary
assets.external: reject document-controlled external image sources; never fetch them
assets.unavailable: retain escaped alt text without an image link; emit a ZIP whenever at least one unavailable image-inline occurrence exists, including when every asset is unavailable

execution.isolation_unit_identity: stable kernel isolation unit or cgroup identity, never PID identity alone
execution.native_call_scope: in-process inside the disposable isolation unit only
execution.hard_kill_target: complete stable isolation unit including every descendant
execution.recovery_precondition: broker termination proof for stable isolation unit is durably recorded
